 Print Fans of Seher Hone Ko Hai will soon have to say goodbye to Mahid, played by Parth Samthaan . The actor has confirmed that the Colors television show will end on November 14 . The announcement came directly from Parth during an Instagram Live, where he spoke to viewers from the sets on what turned out to be his final day of filming. Rather than simply sharing the news, Parth took his followers around the workplace that had been part of his daily routine for the show. He showed them his make-up room and other portions of the set, offering a glimpse into the space where he had spent a considerable amount of time portraying Mahid. Watch Parth Samthaan Reveals His Gym Routine, Diet And What He Avoids Eating To Stay Fit The actor acknowledged that there had been speculation about the show’s future and said he wanted viewers to receive an authentic update. Confirming the development, he stated, “At least you guys have the right to know what is happening and is it happening or is it confirmed. Yes, as Mahid, Parth Samthaan, I want to let you guys know that unfortunately, Seher Hone Ko Hai is going off air by 14th itself this month.” The announcement also marked the end of Parth’s association with the show’s sets, as he revealed that he was shooting for the final time that day. Looking back at the experience, he spoke about the different emotions and situations that had unfolded during the filming. He said, “Bahut saare pal bitaaye hain yahan par, bahut saare ladaai-jhagde hue hain.” The actor also shared his perspective on why the series is ending earlier than expected. According to Parth, the show was not originally meant to conclude at this stage. He went on to say that Colors was not behind the decision to take it off air. However, he stopped short of identifying the people responsible or explaining what led to the development. While the show’s conclusion may disappoint his fans, Parth indicated that he would not be away from work for long. During the live interaction, he revealed that he has other projects in the pipeline and may begin shooting for one of them as early as November. Although he kept the details under wraps, his statement suggests that another professional assignment could be around the corner. Get the latest TV News, TV Shows and more. Download the TOI app.
